title: referenceOf
description: `referenceOf` fills it with every kind, table, relation, stage and check, from the store's schema, kind order and check rows. It is computed on request, and `buildReference` keeps the answer in `referenceCache` while no data file or migration changes.

title: DataFiles
description: `DataFiles` keeps the data file it last found for each record ID while that file still holds it; otherwise `findDataFile` reads each product's data folder for the record's line.

title: useCaseTableFrom
description: `useCaseTableFrom` builds the read model's table from the Use case aggregate's tables, the capabilities, interfaces and every record's ID, on each read: each source table is read once and indexed, and nothing keeps the table between reads. It is the only code that reads the source rows for the queries and the only code that writes the table.

title: problemsTableFrom
description: `problemsTableFrom` builds the read model's table on each read from the checks' run the query runner was given (`ReadView.checked`: the problems `runChecks` found after the load) and the product and domain rows, placing each problem's record in its product up its parents or by its ID; nothing keeps the table between reads. It is the only code that reads the run and the rows for the query and the only code that writes the table.

title: checkTableFrom
description: `checkTableFrom` builds the read model's table from the rows on each read: each source table is read once, and nothing keeps the table between reads. It is the only code that reads the source rows for the queries and the only code that writes the table.

title: indexWorkspace
description: `indexWorkspace` builds the index from each load of `GET /api/spec` (and again on every `spec:changed`): the records in ID order, each one's children, the links both ways, the part rows by owner, the problems by record and the domains by product. `spaceIndex` filters it to one product's records and those of no product, with the links, parts, checks, problems and coverage among them, and keeps one per index and product.

title: domainFolders
description: `ownerFolders`, read through `domainFolders` for a domain and `productFolders` for a product's Shared, fills a stage per schema stage with one folder per kind in kind order, each listing the records that start a branch of the stage, and keeps the result per index and owner, so it is worked out again only when the space's index is built anew on a load.

title: graphMap
description: `graphMap` lays out the Tree map of a root (`mapRootOf`: the product, or the top of a tree no product reaches) from the graph's tree as one icicle, once per load: it is kept per index and root (and text measure), so every focus reads the same map. `nestedMap` keeps the Nested map the same way, and the Voronoi map is laid out in a worker and kept per tree.

title: erdMap
description: erdMap and erdLayout (layout.ts): the product's boxes and lines, built once per index, and their places, laid out once per product and data change and read again for every focus.

title: recordHistory
description: recordHistory: the commits that changed the record's rows, read from git's log and diffs on each request (parseLog, changesInDiff).

title: spaceOf
description: `useSpaceState` maps the products of each loaded index, in ID order, through `spaceOf`: the product's `icon` field when `iconField` accepts it, else its ID's monogram, and its `color` field when `colorField` accepts it, else a color derived from its ID. It is worked out again only when a load gives a new index.

title: baseline
description: `baseline` reads the product folder's rows at the baseline commit from git (`tablesAt`: each data file at that commit through `git show`) and keeps them per commit, since a commit's rows never change; the record diff compares them with the data now on each ask. The app keeps the data before a reload and the Reader's last look as a commit plus the rows that differ from it (`rowDelta`, `applyDelta`).

title: readWorkspace
description: `readWorkspace`, filled from the data files on each load: opens the store afresh, gives each record its part rows (`readRecords`), fills the file facts, runs Lathe's checks then the product's on four connections and the coverage queries side by side; `buildReference`'s answer is kept until the files change. Its shape is `Workspace` in lathe/src/types.ts.

title: keymapTableFrom
description: `resolveCommands`, `platformKeys` and `ariaKeyShortcuts`: `COMMANDS` with the person's overrides, as the platform shows them, worked out once as the app starts.

title: themesTableFrom
description: The built-in themes and the person's own (`themes`), with the one in use (`active`) and the color mode, worked out again from the person's appearance on each change.

title: recentFoldersTableFrom
description: `menuTemplate`'s Open Recent items: each recent folder, latest first, shown with `displayPath`, from the list the shell keeps in memory (read from recent-folders.json as it starts); the menu is rebuilt whenever the list changes.

title: listSessions
description: Reads Claude Code's own session store, one transcript per session under `~/.claude/projects/<folder>/`, and never writes it: each transcript's first and last 64 KB for its title, and the registry of running sessions (`~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json`) for those open elsewhere, each time the picker asks.

title: useViewState
description: The focus page registers a reader of what it shows (its focus, stage, selection and wiki card) while it is mounted, and the app bridge's question calls it, so nothing is kept between questions.

title: chatPatch
description: Writes the chat as the patch from what the page last had: the whole chat when it had none, else only the items that changed.

title: coverageViewsSql
description: `coverageViewsSql` rebuilds the coverage tables and views from the schema on every load, once the file and table facts are in: `test_run`, `pattern_rule_standing`, `owed_pattern_rules`, `obligation_impl`, `obligation_proof`, `trace_link`, `coverage_owed`, `coverage_proof`, `uc_requirement_flow` and `coverage_item` judge each owed obligation and its chain; `coverage_count` counts them per scope and obligation kind, a pattern rule counted for proof alone, `coverage_tests` counts the tests by state and `coverage_gap` lists every gap. Nothing is kept between loads.

title: coverage_gap
description: `coverageViewsSql` recreates `coverage_gap` as a table on every load, from one query over `coverage_item` (each owed obligation not designed, built or proved), the gap rules' minimums by record, and the rules for source files and routes under each product.

title: coverage_tests
description: `coverageViewsSql` makes `coverage_tests` a view on every load: it joins each scope (each domain, and each product outside every domain) to the tests of `test_run` by their record's product and domain, and counts them by state. Nothing is kept between loads.

title: owed_pattern_rules
description: `coverageViewsSql` recreates `owed_pattern_rules` as a table on every load: every rule of each pattern, in every domain that follows it, itself or through a use case.

title: gatherFileFacts
description: On every load `gatherFileFacts` takes every record that names a file, reads each file once however many records name it (a technical record's may be a folder), and notes whether it exists and names the record's ID; the engine then recreates the `file_facts` table with `FACT_TABLES_SQL` and appends one row per record.

title: traceOf
description: `traceOf`, `judge` and `notAutomatedTestsOf` work out, each time a page asks, what designs, builds and proves the record, by group, from the engine's chain of each obligation (`Workspace.chains`, the chain the Trace stage draws) and coverage in the space's index; what proves it in a domain is the tests coverage counts as its proof there. Nothing is stored.

title: gatherTableFacts
description: On every load `gatherTableFacts` reads, once per file, the file each table kept in a database names, finds its definitions with `readDefinitions`, and makes one fact for the table, one for each column `expectedColumns` gives and one for each primary, unique and foreign key, found or not; the engine then recreates `table_facts` with `TABLE_FACTS_SQL` and appends them.

title: followingTableFrom
description: `followingTableFrom` builds the read model's table from the rows on each read: each source table is read once, and nothing keeps the table between reads. It is the only code that reads the source rows for the queries and the only code that writes the table.

title: traceTableFrom
description: `traceTableFrom` builds the read model's table on each read from the checks' run the query runner was given (`ReadView.checked`: the chains and coverage worked out after the load) and the product and domain rows, placing each obligation in its product up its parents or by its ID; nothing keeps the table between reads. It is the only code that reads the run and the rows for the query and the only code that writes the table.
